name: Decorative radial spotlight glow
description: An accent-colored radial gradient fading to transparent, dropped behind a hero or section as a "spotlight" and bright enough against that surface to read as a cloud floating over the copy. It is a reflex AI decoration — the translucent cousin of the saturated radial halo. Let the surface stand on its own, or light the composition with a deliberate material accent rather than a floating colored haze.
snippet: radial-gradient spotlight glow "hud-wash" (#7fb6ff a0.20 → transparent) on 390x844 surface

name: Glowing shadow accents
description: Colored glow shadows — a zero-offset chromatic halo (box- or text-shadow) on any background, or any colored blurred shadow on a dark background — are the default "cool" look of AI-generated UIs. Use neutral elevation shadows and subtle, purposeful lighting instead.
snippet: Colored box-shadow glow (#c8e6ff) on dark background

name: Straggler
description: The last line of this paragraph holds one word, which leaves a hole under the block. Set text-wrap: pretty on body copy (Chrome, Safari) to pull a word down beside it. Where a browser ignores it, edit the last sentence or bind the last two words with a no-break space. Keep it if the break is intended.
snippet: "search." alone on the last of 4 lines (19% of the measure)
